news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Sumit Khurana was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Supertech EV Limited Announces Resignation of Independent Director Sachin Haritash, Effective March 7, 2026
news.body: Supertech EV Limited announced that Mr. Sachin Haritash (DIN: 00050897), Independent Director of the Company, has resigned from the Board of the Company with effect from March 7, 2026, on account of unavoidable personal circumstances as applicable on Independent director. Mr. Sachin Haritash submitted his resignation letter stating that due to unavoidable personal circumstances, he tendered his resignation from the Independent Directorship of the Company with immediate effect, including the board committees, and requested to be relieved from his duties.

news.title: Supertech Ev Limited Appoints Mayank Nigam as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: Supertech EV Limited appointed Mr. Mayank Nigam (ACS: 35514) as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company. Mayank Nigam will be responsible for all functions of a Company Secretary as prescribed under provision of Companies Act, 2013, SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and other duties as assigned by Board of the Company from time to time. Mayank Nigam is a qualified Company Secretary. The appointment was made at the Board of Directors meeting held on January 16, 2026. The effective date of appointment is January 16, 2026. Mayank Nigam replaces Pooja Jain.

news.title: Supertech EV Limited Announces Resignation of Pooja Jain as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 15, 2026
news.body: Supertech EV Limited announced that Ms. Pooja Jain has tendered her resignation from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) and vide her letter dated January 5, 2026 to pursue another opportunity outside the Organization. Pooja Jain will be released from her responsibility with effect from January 15, 2026.
